description: This file defines the CalendarAccountRelationshipManager class, which manages relationships between calendar events (Meeting, Call, Task) and calendar accounts within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and enforcing constraints on these relationships, primarily handling database interactions and relationship logic.

classes.name: CalendarAccountRelationshipManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing relationships between calendar events and calendar accounts, including CRUD operations, relationship enforcement, and data retrieval within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: upsertEventCalendarAccountRelationship
methods.description: Creates or updates the relationship between a calendar event and a calendar account, handling external event IDs and synchronization data.

methods.name: updateRelationshipFields
methods.description: Updates specific fields in the relationship middle table for a given event and calendar account.

methods.name: getRelationshipData
methods.description: Retrieves relationship information such as external event ID, last sync timestamp, and source for an event.

methods.name: ensureUniqueCalendarAccount
methods.description: Enforces a one-to-many relationship constraint by removing other calendar accounts linked to an event, ensuring only one association exists.
